name: bench_ball
description: Single sphere dropped onto the ground plane. Linear elastic force curve (loading curve == unloading curve, zero contact damping) so the contact phase is an exactly-solvable damped-free (lossless) SHM problem, used as a closed-form ground truth for the contact force law + integrator.

metadata.name: OpenMBD Benchmark - Bouncing Ball
metadata.description: Verification model: sphere dropped on ground plane, linear lossless contact.
